text:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — planning a small micro‑beta for the "Latency Tuning" initiative. Goal: recruit 8–10 partners to validate batching/kv-cache configs + rollout telemetry. Need agreement on recruitment criteria, incentives, and launch gates. Thoughts?

Luca: +1. We should require a short technical skim (can they pin model versions + accept SDK hooks) and an org SLA contact. Prefer 6–8 week program.

Tom: From infra: earliest stable infra slot is ~4/15 if we lock the model variants now. Canary + automatic fallback are doable but need the feature-flag rollout for two weeks.

Riley: For measurement, propose a small eval set: 20 representative prompts per partner + 5 stress paths (cold start, long context, KV-heavy). Success criteria: 90th pct latency improvement >= 15% vs baseline OR absolute 90th < 120ms, and no quality regression >0.5% on human evals.

Jess: Incentives suggestion: $3k platform credit + 1x dedicated onboarding session + priority bugs. For enterprise partners, offer SLAs for burst capacity. Also want commitment window: partners agree to a 3‑month post‑pilot follow-up for feedback.

Aisha: Proposal for recruitment short-screener (copy for outreach):
```
1) Do you run LLM inference in production? (yes/no)
2) Avg production QPS or peak tail (example: 20 rps / burst 200)
3) Can you pin model versions and accept SDK hooks for telemetry? (yes/no)
4) Primary latency target (p50/p90) and current baseline
5) Willingness to run a short eval set (20 prompts + 5 stress tests) and share perf + sample outputs (Y/N)
6) Preferred incentive (credits / onboarding / engineering time)
```

Luca: +1 to screener. Also add a checkbox for data sensitivity (PII/PHI) so we can route to Private deployment if needed.

Tom: Operational note — we must include rollback plan in the invite: if regressions detected, auto-fallback to previous model + immediate alert to partner.

Riley: For the eval kit, I'll draft the 20 prompt seed set (mix of short/long/context window/LLM chains). Also propose we capture per-request KV reuse ratio so we can isolate cache benefits.

Jess: Recruitment cadence idea: outreach batch of 20, aim for 8 committed within 2 weeks. If low signups, run a second batch with higher incentive (add $1k credit or 2 hours eng time).

Aisha: Timeline check — recruiting this week, onboarding week of 4/8, canary starts 4/15, monitor two-week canary, roll to all partners by 5/1 if gates pass. Does that feel realistic? :thinking_face:

Tom: Feels tight but achievable if partners can do an integration spike in first week. We should drop any partners who can't produce test telemetry within 7 days.

Luca: Agree. Also propose a small A/B: 4 partners in strict SLA lane, 4 partners in flexible lane to surface different failure modes.

Riley: I'll add evaluation dashboards to the console: per-partner latency histogram, quality regression heatmap, KV hit rate over time.

Jess: I'll draft the outreach message and incentives table. Can we offer a short umbrella NDA for partners who need it? :thumbsup:

Aisha: Yes — legal can push a one‑page NDA. I'll follow up. Final ask: please reply with a single line if you approve the recruiting criteria + timeline.

Luca: Approve.

Tom: Approve.

Riley: Approve.

Jess: Approve.

recruit-bot: outreach batch queued (20 targets) — ETA 2 hours.
